scopeNote: Four representative Canonical WorkDefinitions compiled from exact QA-passed EXECUTOR_READY work-unit semantics. This is a demo compilation slice, not full P6.2 persistence and not full Road LTL compilation.

verification.method: Frozen P6.2 compiler mapping + frozen verifier invariants

definitions.title: Acquire governed BOL/document or API payload
definitions.purpose: Acquire governed document/API evidence for the active Road LTL transaction.

lineage.sourceTaskTitle: Create and validate shipment, consignment and transport-document identity

definitions.trigger: LTL-03 is triggered and governed document/API evidence is required.
actions: Acquire available governed document/API evidence and retain provenance.
evidence: Authority materiality determination: NOT_MATERIAL — this leaf acquires governed evidence and provenance; it does not decide source precedence, approve an exception, or exercise a business authority decision.

executionCharacteristics.outputState: Governed input evidence is available; missing information follows task-level exception policy.

definitions.title: Resolve associated DangerousGoods conditional object family
definitions.purpose: Resolve hazardous basic-description family as one associated object with conditional technical-name/zone and emergency-response evidence where applicable.

lineage.sourceTaskTitle: Create and validate shipment, consignment and transport-document identity

definitions.trigger: DangerousGoods applicability is established for a LineItem.
actions: Resolve identification number, proper shipping name, hazard class/division, packing group where applicable, conditional technical name/zone, and emergency-response information as one associated family.
evidence: Source evidence for the linked DangerousGoods family and conditional applicability.

Authority materiality determination: NOT_MATERIAL — this leaf resolves an associated DangerousGoods family under already-established applicability and source rules; it does not exercise discretionary precedence authority.

executionCharacteristics.outputState: One associated DangerousGoods object family is resolved and linked to the LineItem.

definitions.title: Evaluate request completeness
definitions.purpose: Check whether required parties, locations, cargo profile and requested service/date exist before eligibility evaluation.

lineage.sourceTaskTitle: Resolve service demand and execution eligibility

decisions: PASS when required parties, locations, cargo profile and requested service/date exist; FAIL routes to request correction/HOLD_OR_EXCEPTION.
transitions: FAIL → request correction / HOLD_OR_EXCEPTION; route observed variance to LTL-14.
evidence: CR10 authority materiality: NOT_MATERIAL — the source gives the deterministic completeness condition; no discretionary service-owner authority is required to evaluate presence/absence.

definitions.title: Create or reject transport service request with reason
definitions.purpose: Commit the governed eligibility outcome to the transport service request when applicable gate results permit the action.

lineage.sourceTaskTitle: Resolve service demand and execution eligibility

definitions.trigger: Applicable decision gate permits the state-changing action.
actions: Create or reject the transport service request with reason in the canonical authority system role.
evidence: Eligibility result, rule/policy version, request timestamp and rejection/override record as applicable.

CR10 authority materiality: MATERIAL_AND_RESOLVED — source names performer role, Contracted service owner/controlled override authority, authority object obj-transport-service-request, and authority system sys-tms; runtime executor identity is not required.
